_doc: SO-101 Safety Principles & Parameters. Single source of truth. All tools, scripts, and servers import from here or enforce these values.

principles.P1_no_teleport: Never command a large position jump. All moves must ramp: speed proportional to error, capped per cycle.
principles.P2_know_before_move: Before any actuation, read current state: teleop_active, positions, temps, loads. Refuse if unsafe.
principles.P3_margin_of_safety: Stay 5% inside calibrated range on all sides. Never command raw 0 or 4095.
principles.P4_torque_is_temporary: Torque must auto-disable after every move. Default timeout 2.5s. Teleop disables on stop.
principles.P5_detect_and_halt: Monitor load, temperature, and encoder wraps continuously. Trip immediately on anomaly.
principles.P6_equalize_before_track: Before starting teleop, move follower to match leader position at safe speed. Never start tracking from an unknown state.
principles.P7_human_in_the_loop: Notify the user on any safety trip, unusual state, or before large moves (>500 counts from current position).
principles.P8_collision_freeze: If follower motor load exceeds collision threshold during teleop, freeze that joint at current position. Unfreeze only when load drops below retreat threshold. Never push through resistance.
principles.P9_workspace_aware: Use probed workspace limits (from auto-calibrate and workspace probe) to constrain motion beyond calibration. The robot learns its environment through force feedback and enforces those limits in all move paths.
principles.P10_adaptive_gain: Proportional gain K adjusts dynamically per joint based on tracking error history. Grows when the follower falls behind (sustained error), decays when error is small. Prevents both sluggish tracking and aggressive overshoot.
principles.P11_predictive_collision: Track load derivative (slope) to detect rising forces before they spike. Preemptively slow the joint when load is rising fast and predicted to cross 70% of collision threshold within 250ms.
principles.P12_fatigue_aware: Cumulative thermal stress derates collision thresholds. A motor that has been running hot trips earlier, protecting against torque loss under thermal stress. Heat integral decays when cool.
principles.P13_bidirectional_learning: Collision learning is not one-way. After sustained collision-free operation (2000+ cycles), cautiously loosen tightened calibration limits. Allows the robot to recover range after being moved to a new workspace.

cybernetics._doc: Parameters for the adaptive intelligence layer (P10-P13).

workspace._doc: Workspace limits from cybernetic probing. These override calibration limits where more restrictive. Found by /api/workspace/probe — the robot probed its own joints against the physical environment.

elbow_flex.note: Desk surface at ~100-150 counts. Probed 2026-05-14. Flat limit regardless of shoulder_lift.
